headlines.title: Lakers controlling owner Jeanie Buss opposes sale of family s stake to Bob Iger, Joshua Kushner
headlines.summary: Jeanie Buss's lawyer says she has not agreed to sell the team and that any vote suggesting the Buss family is selling "would be and is void."

headlines.title: Disney s new parks boss outlines investment strategy, with superfans at the fore
headlines.summary: Disney Experiences chief Thomas Mazloum is focused on balancing the needs of its most ardent parkgoers with its less frequent visitors.

headlines.title: Paramount seeks $1.88 billion bond from state AGs to cover costs of WBD merger delay

headlines.title: What will TV look like in three years? Media insiders share their predictions
headlines.summary: CNBC asked media insiders what they think the TV market — from pay TV subscribers to sports ratings — will look like in three years.

headlines.title: Synchrony, credit card issuer to Amazon and Walmart, partners with OpenAI for ChatGPT shopping
headlines.summary: Maran Nalluswami, Synchrony's chief strategy officer, told CNBC it will probably take six to 12 months to get payments fully integrated into ChatGPT.

headlines.title: I drove Tesla FSD, Rivian Autonomy+ ‘hands-free’ driving systems. Here’s how they compare
headlines.summary: Rivian is trying to catch up to Tesla's "hands-free" capabilities, but with additional safety guardrails that the Elon Musk company doesn't have.

headlines.title: Group including Jeff Bezos buys minority stake in Liverpool FC, with option to become controlling owner
headlines.summary: The group that includes Jeff Bezos has an option to become the majority shareholder within the next year.

headlines.title: Disney CEO Josh D Amaro tells CNBC parks were big surprise in last quarter, company has clarity and stability
headlines.summary: New CEO Josh D'Amaro has said his strategy for continued growth at Disney is centered around storytelling, intellectual property and technology.

headlines.title: Lamborghini unveils Revuelto SV, its most powerful production car ever
headlines.summary: Lamborghini's Revuelto SV is a limited-edition V12 hybrid with over 1,050 horsepower, a 2.4-second 0-to-100 kph time and a $741,172 starting price.

headlines.title: Housing investors say this is their worst market in at least 3 years
headlines.summary: Mortgage rates hit a recent low at the end of February but rose sharply at the start of the war with Iran. They are now at their highest level in over a year.

headlines.title: Monterey Car Week auctions could hit a record $500 million, with help from younger buyers
headlines.summary: A new generation of millennials and Gen Zers is taking over the collecting market from baby boomers and bidding up modern supercars at Monterey Car Week.

headlines.title: The ‘20% rule’ behind Giorgos Tsetis’ blueprint for a new kind of family office

headlines.title: Bob Iger, Joshua Kushner buy Los Angeles Lakers at a $12.5 billion valuation, source says

headlines.title: Wendy s stock jumps on report of potential takeover bid from Nelson Peltz s Trian Fund Management
headlines.summary: Peltz's relationship with Wendy's dates back to an activist campaign he led more than two decades ago.

headlines.title: Why Jensen Huang’s $500 billion AI financing plan faces a big risk from China

headlines.title: Home Depot CEO taking temporary medical leave, two top execs to run the retailer
headlines.summary: Home Depot's CEO, Ted Decker, is taking a temporary medical leave of absence that's expected to last a few months.

headlines.summary: The CEO of the nation's largest single-family rental landlord said the new law banning large-scale investors from the market will lower prices in the long term.

headlines.title: Why JPMorgan is investing big in the 2028 LA Olympics
headlines.summary: JPMorgan is making a nine-figure bet as the Olympics Games' first-ever global banking partner.

마이크론과 샌디스크 등 메모리 반도체 주식, AI 지출 신뢰로 상승세 기록
